QIMING / HOW

How it works

Connect the project entry, work, managed assets, knowledge, and verification in one recoverable directory.

01

Read the room

Inspect the directory, project instructions, existing material, and current goal. Your names and structure come first.

02

Create an entry

Establish a project-owned instance, short handoff, and agent instructions so a new session knows where to continue.

03

Keep the outcome

Retain tasks, errors, knowledge, scripts, Skills, and MCPs according to their real maintenance value.

Q+
MEMBERS / WHAT STAYS

A “member” is a managed object, not a subscription.

Projects, accounts, devices, reusable scripts, Skills, programs, and MCPs can each have an identity, owner, and handoff record when you maintain them over time. Internal files stay with their parent. Passwords and keys are represented only by references to secure storage.

Stable identityOrigin and ownerReal verificationNext step
PROJECT / BEFORE + AFTER

From a conversation to work you can resume

Before adoption

Decisions live in chats. Drafts and tasks mix together. A new assistant needs the whole story again.

project/
  README.md
  drafts/
  assets/

After adoption

Your files stay where they are. A project entry points to current work, evidence and next steps. Reusable tools and knowledge have an owner.

project/
  README.md, drafts/, assets/  ← preserved
  AGENTS.md                   ← startup
  .qiming/START.md             ← current progress
  .qiming/work/                ← tasks and evidence
  .qiming/knowledge/           ← reusable findings
  .qiming/members/             ← maintained objects

Real fresh-session check · synthetic records

On 2026-10-01, Codex and Claude Code independently read a demo project: sections one and two were recorded as complete; section three still needed checking, specifically the order of April 12 and April 15. Both cited START.md and the task record and noted missing acceptance evidence. This is a continuity smoke check, not the full behavior matrix. Gemini required login and was not verified.

How the next session continues

Your request → project instructions → START.md → current record → plan and apply → verification, journal and next step

Load a small set of essential rules, then retrieve records for the current task. JSON holds structured records, Markdown explains them, and SQLite is a rebuildable index. The full knowledge base does not load into every session.

Keep long-running projects readable

Keep 3–5 active tasks in START.md. Archive completed records while preserving IDs; search marks knowledge due for review. Startup summaries warn above 3,000 bytes and refuse refresh above 12,000. Preview upgrades and retain local changes.
